sections.Profile:
"Bo Bo" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in 1961. Designed by Steve Kordek, it features a circus theme with two flippers and a unique cocktail-style cabinet that includes drink holders, reflecting the 1960s design aesthetics.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Art: George Molentin
